content:
Evolution of a Global Bubble Tea Ingredient Innovator # Our Beginnings # Founded in 2001, Empire Eagle Food set out with a clear vision: to transform the bubble tea industry by leading in ingredient innovation and supply. What began as a local manufacturing operation in Taiwan quickly grew into an international enterprise, now exporting premium tea and powder products to over 40 countries across five continents.
Growth and Transformation # Initially, our focus was on meeting the rising demand for bubble tea ingredients. However, as the industry evolved, so did our mission. We embraced innovation and adaptability, striving not just to supply, but to redefine the standards of the bubble tea market.
Key Milestones # 2015: Launch of Boba Empire # Boba Empire Launch 2015 In 2015, we introduced Boba Empire, a wholesale brand dedicated to serving the foodservice industry with high-quality bubble tea ingredients. Exploring the World of Bubble Tea Toppings # Bubble tea is celebrated not just for its refreshing flavors, but for the unique sensory experience it offers. The addition of various toppings transforms each drink into a personalized creation, allowing for endless combinations and textures. Whether you prefer the classic chewiness of tapioca pearls or the playful burst of popping boba, the world of bubble tea toppings is rich with possibilities.
The Role of Toppings in Bubble Tea # Toppings are more than just an add-on—they are integral to the bubble tea experience. Each type of topping brings its own texture and flavor, enhancing the overall enjoyment of the beverage. From pairing with traditional milk tea to complementing fruit teas and signature blends, toppings inspire creativity and cater to a wide range of preferences.
Categories of Bubble Tea Toppings # Tapioca Boba Pearls Popping Boba Cocktail Popping Boba Savory Popping Boba Jelly Popping Boba Crystal Boba Jelly Nata de Coco Canned Toppings Bag Toppings Jam Tapioca Boba Pearls: The classic, chewy pearls that started it all, offering a satisfying texture in every sip. Popping Boba: Juice-filled spheres that burst with flavor, adding a playful element to your drink. Cocktail Popping Boba: A creative twist on popping boba, often infused with unique flavors for a more adventurous experience. Savory Popping Boba: For those seeking something different, these offer a savory profile to complement select beverages. Jelly Popping Boba: Combining the texture of jelly with the fun of popping boba. Crystal Boba: Translucent and slightly chewy, these pearls provide a lighter alternative to traditional tapioca. Jelly: Silky and smooth, jellies come in various flavors and shapes, perfect for adding both color and texture. Nata de Coco: Coconut gel cubes that are both chewy and refreshing. Canned Toppings: Ready-to-use toppings that add richness and convenience. Bag Toppings: Conveniently packaged for easy use and storage. Jam: Adds a fruity layer to your beverage, enhancing both taste and aroma. Customization and Creativity # The diversity of toppings ensures that bubble tea remains a dynamic and ever-evolving category. With so many options, every customer can craft a drink that suits their individual taste and mood. This flexibility is a key reason why bubble tea continues to captivate and delight consumers around the world.

我們的理念——「奶茶無極限」，不僅是創新方向，更是一種願景。我們相信珍珠奶茶市場的潛力無窮無盡，而我們每天都在突破它的界限。
如今，我們的足跡遍及五大洲、超過40個國家，成為珍珠奶茶產業中真正的全球領導者。
遍及40多國家 西部非洲拓展 不同國家文化 近年來，我們更進一步深入西部非洲——一個鮮少台灣移民、幾乎沒有珍珠奶茶的地方。這一大膽的舉動展現了我們的決心：將這款台灣代表性飲品帶到世界的每個角落，無論多麼意想不到。
我們的旅程還遠未結束。以高品質的茶葉與奶精為基礎，我們正努力實現品牌願景：讓珍珠奶茶成為一種全球語言，受到不同文化背景的人們喜愛。每進入一個新市場，我們就離目標更近一步，向世界分享台灣珍珠奶茶的豐富文化與創意。
